annotations.title: Check on-ramp coverage for a county

description: Whether a US county (or a whole state) can be added to Fabrica through the on-ramp: supported, notConfigured or unsupported, and for a supported county the deed and forms the owner signs (and which are notarized), witness requirements, the questions the owner is asked, and the on-ramp steps. Answers from a table of Fabrica's on-ramp rules as of 2026-10-16, refreshed by hand, so each answer carries that date; the on-ramp page is the live answer. Give a 5-digit county FIPS, or a two-letter state with or without a county. No fee amounts (ask_fabrica has them) and no owner data.

ownerType.description: Who holds title today: individual (default), entity or concurrent (co-owners)

name: check_county_coverage
